history: R1 Scala compile failed with 14 errors: missing imported helper inputs. R2 adds exact helpers and separates static 24-input ABI metadata, without compiling the software functional-model body.

Original independent REVIEW.json pins earlier mapper/loader/driver revisions and syntax-only SHA validation; it is historical, not a review of current final hashes. INTEGRITY_REVIEW.json binds final EVP full same-open-mmap SHA validation.
Initial configuration load failed on allocation naming; repaired load passed five profiles. Both logs remain pinned.
Invalid Transform enum bypass and comment-separated DPI / automatic module inventory issues were found and repaired; the original reports retain chronology.

Publication reviewer found that the first public verifier accepted a symlinked MANIFEST. Actual package contained no symlinks; the verifier now rejects symlinked root, manifest, directories and members. The original probe and pre-fix package manifest remain in local audit history.
limits: The Simulation/full-DUT C++ branch has never compiled in this batch; source protocol inspection is not a bus simulation pass.
Source specifies single outstanding half-duplex, next-beat response; this is not LPDDR timing or a performance model.

Sparse writes commit after B handshake in uncompiled Simulation source. Budget is 8388608 64-byte beats (512 MiB payload plus metadata), not a reduction of the logical 2 GiB address window. Exceeding budget rejects; no eviction.

EVP hashes the same open read-only private mmap before use, with fstat checks. It is not OS immutability: concurrent writes/truncation can race checks, contaminate bytes or SIGBUS. Exclusive external ownership is required.
Allocation coverage and overlap validation are lazy at reads; no eager whole-image coverage proof.
assemble_sv.py inventories module definitions only; identical bodies do not prove preprocessor equivalence, authorize deduplication, linking, or DUT correctness.
Capture contains old unused validators. The latest capture and FMA emitter main functions were not run by this batch. New independent emission work is out of scope.
No generated SV, IR, class/ELF, memory bytes, sampled weight hex, NPZ or recoverable encoded payload is published.
No numeric, RTL, QoR, utilization or whole-model support claim; all five M128 numerical/RTL results remain 0/5, MoE tie still pending.
